name: vm-gen
description: Generate self-contained, per-build-unique protected virtual machines in JavaScript and Lua from a small source language, using bytecode virtualization and code-protection techniques.

scripts.example:js: node bin/vm-gen.js build examples/fib.vgs -t js -o examples/fib.vm.js && node examples/fib.vm.js
scripts.example:lua: node bin/vm-gen.js build examples/fib.vgs -t lua -o examples/fib.vm.lua
